description: Ignore one rule on the pages of a website whose path matches a glob, for example rule core/meta-title with /blog/archive/**. Later audits leave those findings out of the report and its score, and open tracker issues every page of which the ignore covers move to the reversible status ignored (never resolved). The report, list_issues and get_report say how many findings were suppressed. Applies only when the organization has path ignores switched on. For a rule that does not apply anywhere on the site use update_website_settings disable_rules instead. Needs the audits:write scope and an owner or admin role. A path glob: * matches within one path segment, ** matches across segments, ? matches one character, everything else is literal (no regex). Matched against the page path only (no host, query or fragment, no trailing slash), at most 200 characters.
